title: Says your KYC, PAN or Aadhaar needs urgent action
why: KYC updates never happen through a text link or a phone call. This is the most common bank-fraud message in India.
examples: Dear customer your SBI KYC is pending and your account will be blocked today. Update now.
Your PAN card is invalid, verify immediately or your account will be deactivated.
आपका केवाईसी अपडेट नहीं है, खाता बंद हो जाएगा।
safe: Your KYC has been updated successfully. Thank you for banking with us.
Aadhaar number verification completed for your SIM.
